name: dekko
description: Static code map for LLM agents. dekko parses the repository with tree-sitter into MAP.md and map.json (every file, function, signature, type, and call edge) without spending model tokens; an 18-tool MCP server (search_code, outline, query_symbol, get_callers, workset, impacted_tests, ...) answers structural questions from that map instead of grep and whole-file reads; skills steer the agent toward the map, map the repo, name the tests a change impacts, diagnose the install, and cross-check low call counts.
